Marketing Officer Job at Demeterra Agro Limited (DAL)




        
    

        
        At Demeterra Agro Limited (DAL), we're building the future of agriculture by bridging the gap between farmers and markets. We integrate a market-based system that enables seamless, direct connections between smallholder farmers and buyers, ensuring better access to inputs, data, and fair pricing. From commodity sales to customized agri-input distribution, we empower farmers to thrive while meeting real-time market demands.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Marketing Officer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 

Description
     

            
    




	Great marketers don't just sell, they change lives. 
	Now we're looking for bold, creative Marketing Officers to help take our Food Finance Initiative further.
	If you know how to connect with people, win trust and turn conversations into results, this is your stage.
	Your ideas will open doors, and every sale will put food on someone's table.
	You bring passion, confidence and a hunger to grow. We bring purpose, great rewards and impact you can see.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Project Manager - Telecom Site Build

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Contract (1-Year Contract, Subject to Renewal)

Role Summary


	M-P Infrastructure Limited is seeking an experienced and results-driven Project Manager &ndash; Telecom Site Build to oversee the execution and delivery of telecom site projects.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for managing civil and structural works, coordinating project teams and stakeholders, ensuring quality and HSE compliance, and delivering sites ready for installation in line with approved designs, specifications, and project timelines.


Key Responsibilities
Project Execution &amp; Site Delivery:


	Oversee civil and structural works across telecom site projects.
	Ensure sites are completed and handed over ready for installation, in line with the Scope of Work (SOW) and specifications.
	Monitor project progress, quality, safety, and adherence to approved design drawings.


Client Interface &amp; Reporting:


	Serve as the primary point of contact for the client.
	Prepare and submit weekly/monthly progress reports, meeting minutes, and project dashboards.
	Manage BOQs, track quantities, variations, and reconcile with procurement.
	Lead stakeholder engagement with communities, vendors, landlords, and regulatory bodies.


Planning &amp; Coordination:


	Develop project schedules, resource plans, and budget tracking.
	Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams to achieve project milestones.
	Manage site risks, issues, and change requests.
	Ensure compliance with HSE standards and company QA/QC procedures.


Closeout &amp; Handover:


	Ensure site readiness for closure and handover.
	Compile as-built documents, test reports, and handover packs.
	Secure client sign-off and complete project closeout.


Key Requirements


	B.Eng / B.Sc in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field.
	Minimum of 10 years of experience managing telecom, civil, or infrastructure site projects.
	Strong experience in tower/telecom site build projects is preferred.
	Understanding of TSS, foundation works, tower erection, earthing, retaining walls, and fencing.
	Strong BOQ management, reporting, and client management skills.
	Proficiency in MS Project, MS Excel, and AutoCAD reading.
	PMP/PRINCE2 certification is an advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Strong leadership and problem-solving skills on site
	Excellent stakeholder management and communication
	Commercial awareness, including cost control, BOQ, and variation management
	HSE conscious and quality-driven
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines


Salary
N500,000 / Month (Gross).

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: careers@mpiafrica.org using &quot;Project Manager - Telecom Site Build&quot; as the subject of the email.

Project Manager - Telecom Site Build Job at M-P Infrastructure Limited




        
    

        
        M-P Infrastructure Limited is a leading infrastructure development and management company. We focus on ICT, Renewable Energy, Power, Water, Technology, Oil/Gas Process Facilities and Real Estate, offering the entire value chain of solutions from Audit, design and construction, to operation and maintenance across several industries including Telecoms, Energy, Oil Gas and Real Estate.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Project Manager - Telecom Site Build

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Contract (1-Year Contract, Subject to Renewal)

Role Summary
     

            
    




	M-P Infrastructure Limited is seeking an experienced and results-driven Project Manager – Telecom Site Build to oversee the execution and delivery of telecom site projects.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for managing civil and structural works, coordinating project teams and stakeholders, ensuring quality and HSE compliance, and delivering sites ready for installation in line with approved designs, specifications, and project timelines.


Key Responsibilities
Project Execution & Site Delivery:


	Oversee civil and structural works across telecom site projects.
	Ensure sites are completed and handed over ready for installation, in line with the Scope of Work (SOW) and specifications.
	Monitor project progress, quality, safety, and adherence to approved design drawings.


Client Interface & Reporting:


	Serve as the primary point of contact for the client.
	Prepare and submit weekly/monthly progress reports, meeting minutes, and project dashboards.
	Manage BOQs, track quantities, variations, and reconcile with procurement.
	Lead stakeholder engagement with communities, vendors, landlords, and regulatory bodies.


Planning & Coordination:


	Develop project schedules, resource plans, and budget tracking.
	Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams to achieve project milestones.
	Manage site risks, issues, and change requests.
	Ensure compliance with HSE standards and company QA/QC procedures.


Closeout & Handover:


	Ensure site readiness for closure and handover.
	Compile as-built documents, test reports, and handover packs.
	Secure client sign-off and complete project closeout.


Key Requirements


	B.Eng / B.Sc in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field.
	Minimum of 10 years of experience managing telecom, civil, or infrastructure site projects.
	Strong experience in tower/telecom site build projects is preferred.
	Understanding of TSS, foundation works, tower erection, earthing, retaining walls, and fencing.
	Strong BOQ management, reporting, and client management skills.
	Proficiency in MS Project, MS Excel, and AutoCAD reading.
	PMP/PRINCE2 certification is an advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Strong leadership and problem-solving skills on site
	Excellent stakeholder management and communication
	Commercial awareness, including cost control, BOQ, and variation management
	HSE conscious and quality-driven
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines


Salary
N500,000 / Month (Gross).

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Project Manager - Telecom Site Build" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Brand Manager Job at Street Souk




        
    

        
        Street Souk is Africa's largest and most influential youth-led streetwear convention and cultural community. Founded in 2018 by Iretidayo "Ireti" Zaccheaus, the platform serves as a massive commercial hub that connects hundreds of upcoming and established African fashion brands with thousands of active consumers. Primarily based in Lagos, Nigeria, it has rapidly evolved into a global movement that fuses fashion, music, and skate culture.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Brand Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Description
     

            
    




	The Brand Manager will oversee the brands featured on Street Souk's platform, managing their day-to-day performance, sales, and inventory to ensure that the brands are available to the community and commercially successful.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage the day-to-day brand performance and coordinate re-up
	Track sales, inventory levels and product performance.
	Coordinate product availability, deliveries and inventory replenishment.
	Maintain accurate inventory records and monitor stock movement.
	Work with brands to resolve product and operational issues.
	Ensure products are properly presented across Street Souk's platform, stores and events.
	Prepare regular sales, inventory and performance reports.
	Identify opportunities to improve sales and grow brand performance.
	Coordinate with sales, operations and project teams to ensure smooth execution.


Requirements


	3+ years of experience in brand management, retail, sales, merchandising or a related field.
	Strong understanding of sales, inventory and product management.
	Excellent organisational and communication skills.
	Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple brands and products.
	Comfortable working with sales, inventory and performance reports.
	Commercially minded, proactive and solution-oriented.
	Experience in fashion, retall, streetwear or consumer brands is an advantage.

Sales Representative Job at Street Souk




        
    

        
        Street Souk is Africa's largest and most influential youth-led streetwear convention and cultural community. Founded in 2018 by Iretidayo "Ireti" Zaccheaus, the platform serves as a massive commercial hub that connects hundreds of upcoming and established African fashion brands with thousands of active consumers. Primarily based in Lagos, Nigeria, it has rapidly evolved into a global movement that fuses fashion, music, and skate culture

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Representative

Job Location: Lagos

Description
     

            
    




	We're looking for Sales Representatives to support sales across the Street Souk store and vendor booths at the December Convention.
	You'll engage customers, drive sales and ensure a great shopping experience throughout the event.


Key Responsibilities


	Drive sales across the Street Souk store and assigned booths.
	Engage customers and confidently communicate product information.
	Process sales and payments accurately.
	Maintain product displays and keep sales areas organised.
	Track stock and flag low-stock items or issues.
	Support customers with product selection and enquiries.
	Meet assigned sales targets throughout the convention.


Requirements


	Previous experience in retail, sales or customer service is an advantage.
	Excellent communication and people skills.
	Confident, energetic and customer-focused.
	Comfortable working in a fast-paced event environment.
	Strong attention to detail and ability to handle transactions accurately.
	Available to work throughout the December Convention.
